question: Will the U.S. labor force participation rate (BLS, seasonally adjusted) for February 2026 (the latest monthly reading dated on or before 2026-02-14) be above 62.4%, its value for December 2025?

rule.threshold_basis: the latest reading as of 2026-01-15 (December 2025), rounded as shown

source: Source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics
